summary: Licensed veterinarian with 10 years of continuous clinical experience across small-animal general practice, emergency care, and shelter medicine. Skilled in diagnostics, surgery, preventive care, and client education, with a record of improving patient outcomes and clinic efficiency in growing mid-market practices.

experience.title: Veterinarian (DVM, State Veterinary License)
bullets: Examine 20-25 animals per day to detect and determine the nature of diseases and injuries, documenting findings in the practice management system.
Treat sick or injured animals by prescribing medication, setting bones, dressing wounds, and performing soft-tissue surgeries including spays, neuters, and mass removals.
Collect body tissue, feces, blood, urine, and other fluids for laboratory examination and analysis, interpreting results to guide treatment plans.
Operate radiographic and ultrasound equipment and interpret resulting images to diagnose fractures, foreign bodies, and abdominal conditions.
Inoculate animals against rabies, distemper, parvovirus, and other diseases, maintaining a 95% on-time vaccination rate across the patient panel.
Counsel clients about pet loss, hospice care, and euthanasia decisions with empathy while ensuring informed consent and comfort-focused protocols.

experience.title: Associate Veterinarian
bullets: Diagnosed and treated medical and surgical cases across a caseload of 4,000+ patients, collaborating with senior veterinarians on complex presentations.
Performed emergency triage, wound management, and stabilization for after-hours cases, reducing average patient wait time by 18%.
Educated the public about zoonotic diseases such as rabies and leptospirosis through community outreach and client handouts.
Advised owners on sanitary measures, feeding, general care, medical conditions, and treatment options during 15-20 consultations per shift.
Maintained accurate controlled-substance and medical records in compliance with state and DEA requirements.

experience.title: Veterinarian
experience.employer: a nonprofit animal shelter and community clinic
bullets: Provided high-volume spay/neuter surgery and preventive care for shelter animals and low-income community clients.
Examined animals to identify injuries and illnesses and developed treatment plans within resource constraints.
Administered vaccinations against rabies and distemper and conducted wellness screenings for intake and adoption clearance.
Trained veterinary assistants on patient restraint, sample collection, and diagnostic equipment operation.

experience.title: Veterinary Intern / Extern
bullets: Assisted licensed veterinarians with examinations, diagnostic imaging, and surgical preparation for small and large animals.
Collected blood, urine, and tissue samples and performed routine in-house laboratory testing under supervision.
Documented patient histories and client communications, supporting continuity of care across appointments.

education.institution: a state university college of veterinary medicine

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Animal Science
